def max_monsters_defeated(N, A, B):
    # Initialize a DP array where dp[i] represents the maximum monsters that can be defeated up to town i
    dp = [0] * (N + 2)
    
    # Iterate over each hero
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        # Calculate the maximum monsters that can be defeated if the i-th hero attacks town i
        dp[i] = max(dp[i], dp[i - 1])
        dp[i + 1] = max(dp[i + 1], dp[i - 1] + min(A[i], B[i]))
